programs.name: Computer Science
programs.description: Modern CS program in the heart of the Alps. Software engineering, AI, and information systems. Innsbruck's Digital Science Center connects academic research with Tyrolean tech industry.

programs.name: Environmental Sciences
programs.description: Ecology, climate science, and environmental management. Alpine environment provides unique research opportunities. Focus on sustainable mountain development and biodiversity.

programs.name: Sports Science
programs.description: Austria's leading sports science program. Exercise physiology, sports medicine, and coaching science. Innsbruck's alpine sports environment provides excellent practical training opportunities.

programs.name: Physics
programs.description: Theoretical and experimental physics with specializations in astrophysics, particle physics, and quantum technology. Alpine location provides opportunities for astrobiology and atmospheric research.
entryRequirements: Mathematics and Physics at advanced secondary level

programs.name: Economics
programs.description: International economics, finance, and economic policy. English-taught. Small cohort sizes allow for personalized education. Focus on European economic integration.

programs.name: Psychology
programs.description: Austria's largest psychology program outside Vienna. Clinical psychology, health psychology, and research methodology. Innsbruck's healthcare system provides clinical training opportunities.

programs.name: Law
programs.description: Traditional four-year law program in civil law tradition. European law, constitutional law, and commercial law. Faculty of Law is one of Austria's oldest.

programs.name: Pharmacy
programs.description: Five-year pharmacy program leading to Magister pharmaciae. Pharmaceutical sciences, pharmacology, and clinical pharmacy. Prepares for careers in pharmacy, pharma industry, and healthcare.
entryRequirements: Chemistry and Biology at secondary school
